text:
Anna (Product): quick heads-up — I'm working on a tiny UX spec to surface routing/quota hints in the per-route saved queries panel
Samir (Platform): nice, are you thinking inline token-cost estimates or more of a model-fallback hint? :thinking_face:
Anna (Product): both ideally. small chip: cost estimate + an affordance to view fallback models and their expected latency/cost
Mike R (Console): we need to be careful with telemetry noise — estimates should be based on sampled request profiles, not global averages
Jessie (Eng): agreed. we can compute per-route histogram of seq lengths and route-level model mix, then surface a 95th pct latency and median cost estimate
Samir (Platform): that's doable but we must not query the heavy rollup at render time. cache TTL should be minutes and invalidate on routing policy changes
Anna (Product): UX question — where do we put it? inside saved query list row or in the inspector flyout? small experiments preferred
Mike R (Console): prefer row-level chip with hover for more detail. list is dense already though. maybe compact pill + expand arrow that opens quick-inspector
Jessie (Eng): implementation note: quick-inspector should call /internal/route-cost-preview with route_id + sample_window and return small JSON: {"median_cost":"xxx","p95_latency":"yyy","fallbacks":["gpt-small","opt-2.7b"]} — we can gzip and cache it
Samir (Platform): minor API nudge: call should include model_pin context. routing rules can change result set; include policy_version in the payload so UI can show stale warnings
Anna (Product): good call. also add a subtle stale indicator (clock emoji) when policy_version != latest
Mike R (Console): UX micro-question: if user edits saved query and changes route pin, do we re-run preview automatically? automatic re-run would be useful but could surprise quota metering
Jessie (Eng): auto-run only after user stops typing for 2s or clicks "apply preview". default is off for large accounts, opt-in in prefs
Samir (Platform): quota/preview safety: preview responses must be aggregated from sampled data and tagged with sampling_rate so we can normalize estimates. include an explanation in hoverhelp
Anna (Product): wording draft for hover: "Estimates are computed from sampled recent traffic for this route. Actual costs vary with sequence length and model selection. For precise billing, run a live sample."
Mike R (Console): +1. also let's store the last preview snapshot id on the saved query object so audits can show when previews were taken
Samir (Platform): backend will emit a preview.snapshot_created audit event with snapshot_id, policy_version, sample_window, and sampling_rate
deploy-bot: deployment queued for /internal/route-cost-preview v1 at 2024-08-01T14:30Z
Anna (Product): thanks — next steps: mockups by EOD Friday, API shape in a short ADR, and small perf guardrails. I'll create a tiny ticket and tag y'all
Mike R (Console): ping when mockups ready, I can test density and accessibility
Jessie (Eng): I'll prototype the preview endpoint and sampling normalization
Samir (Platform): I'll add policy_version plumbing and caching strategy
Anna (Product): :thumbsup: thanks team"
